description: The REFUSAL of `replace` between ENTITIES: the consumers of an entity are linked to its children (identifier type of the FKs, attributes, anonymous record, list type) and ReplaceReferences does not map them -- in O11 it left 1 consumer on the source ('native replacement was incomplete'), in ODC it left the module with missing anonymous structures (InvalidGlobalStateException 6), measured on 2026-09-23. Since the phase 3 data lot the kernel refuses before touching the model. Proven alternatives: rename the entity (rename), or re-point the attributes one by one (replace between attributes, tests/jobs/entity-refactor.json).
expectError: replace: IServerEntity 'Contact' is an entity and cannot be repointed
Rename it, or move the consumers to the other entity by hand
